name: claude
checked: Claude Code 2.1.220 `claude --help`; one-shot call run live 2026-09-13; Claude Code 2.1.280 headless auto mode ran a unittest command live 2026-09-23
notes: Print mode reads the prompt from stdin; --output-format json returns one object with result and is_error. Model accepts aliases such as sonnet or opus. The default is auto: its classifier approves ordinary edits and commands such as running tests and blocks risky ones, which headless mode needs because nobody can answer a prompt. Under acceptEdits file edits are accepted but every shell command is denied in headless mode; use it only with --allowedTools for the specific commands, or when auto mode is unavailable on your account.
